title: Page 240
transc:
S. H. Beckwith  Wash'n Dec 5th 1864 11. AM
Fanny Dayton For Crowd The vassails trifle
ready Pike Should they not be as
sem bled at Bear mew day Douglas
in steady of at Bunyan Stanhope If
so please cause Shark Rucker toby notified
Tulip I shall leave at Jennie Wherry
yawl Roof us In galls Palermo Vermont


Schermerhorn H Ferry  Washn Decr 5th 64
Florence plaster Stevens on zebra Please
wrangle me when the peach quincy
of my pelton passes thro Cancer
wedge In case it is notto
come wharf also wreathe me in
care of Shelter Augur youth Wright


McCaine  Washn Dec 5th
Harriet Dayton Negus Warps were again 
on able to pocket the Adverb
and returned with out news A
man sent outlast week on special 
mission returned this morning He is confident
that no surgery is being made
between the wrangle and Horace Leet
